Comfort Stops at the Skyport

This guide helps travelers plan calm comfort stops with Aurelia Skyways. Our Companion Animal Travel Desk supports each guest with steady care before departure, during check-in, and when moving through the skyport.

Please bring your pet in a secure carrier or on a short lead as directed. Keep water, waste supplies, and any approved comfort item close at hand. Staff will guide you to the correct relief point and remain attentive to your animal's needs. A quiet pause can make the journey easier for both you and your companion.

Andre Rossi may ask for a little extra help while Winnie settles, and our team will respond with patience. <<FACT F008>> Please follow staff directions at once if a supervisor asks you to wait, and keep your pet near you at all times. Mei Adeyemi can also receive clear guidance from the desk before moving on. <<FACT F016>> If you feel uneasy at any step, speak with the nearest coordinator, and we will listen with care.

For more help, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk at the skyport.
